name: browser-use
headline: Cuti - AI Development & Multi-Agent Orchestration
short_description: Cuti is an AI development environment and multi-agent orchestration tool for Claude Code. It provides a dev container, Clawdbot, command queuing, prompt history, and alias management. Ideal for operations teams automating workflows and managing AI agents.
author: nociza

sections.overview:
Cuti provides an instant Docker-based development environment with Claude Code pre-configured by default, plus multi-agent orchestration capabilities. It includes command queuing with priority execution, a read-only ops console for monitoring provider readiness and queue state, and provider-aware setup for Claude, OpenClaw, and other AI models. The tool handles smart rate limiting, automatic retries, and persistent authentication across sessions. Operations teams use Cuti to automate workflows, manage multiple AI agents, inspect chat history, and switch between Claude versions or providers without rebuilding containers.
Launch isolated Claude Code development environments with pre-configured API authentication
Orchestrate multi-agent AI workflows across Claude and OpenClaw providers
Monitor agent queue state and provider readiness via the ops console
Automate task management with built-in todo system for AI agents
